title: Root of a straight line
summary: The line y = m·x + b evaluated at a probe position, with its root x = −b/m when one exists.

m.label: Slope
m.description: Change in y for each unit step in x.

b.label: Intercept
b.description: Value of y where the line meets x = 0.

p.label: Probe position
p.description: Position x at which the line is read.

probe.x.label: Probe position
probe.x.meaning: The probe position p; equal to the parameter p.

probe.value.label: Line value at the probe
probe.value.signConvention: Positive values lie above the x-axis.

slope.label: Slope
slope.meaning: The slope m of the line; equal to the parameter m.
slope.signConvention: Positive when y increases to the right.

intercept.label: Intercept
intercept.meaning: The value of the line at x = 0; equal to the parameter b.

root.label: Root
root.meaning: The x where y = 0: −b/m when m ≠ 0. With m = 0 it is undefined: NO_ROOT when b ≠ 0, EVERY_X_IS_A_ROOT when b = 0.

line.label: Line
line.description: The line between x = −5 and x = 5 (two exact endpoints).

probe-point.label: Probe point
probe-point.description: The point (p, y(p)) on the line.

root-point.label: Root
root-point.description: The point (x_r, 0), or a gap with the reason when the root is undefined.

constraints.message: The line value at the probe, m·p + b, must stay between −10 and 10, the plotted range.
constraints.recovery: Move the probe closer to x = 0, or reduce the slope or the intercept.

interpretation.coordinateConvention: x increases to the right and y upward in one dimensionless plane.
assumptions: The line is exactly y = m·x + b with real coefficients; nothing is sampled except the two drawn endpoints.
limitations: The probe value is limited to [−10, 10] by the coupled constraint so it stays in the plotted range.
A root outside [−5, 5] is valid but lies outside the drawn line segment.

sources.citation: Hand derivation: m·x + b = 0 gives x = −b/m for m ≠ 0. For m = 0 the line is the horizontal line y = b, which never meets y = 0 when b ≠ 0 and coincides with it when b = 0.
